profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Wayfair
profile.summary: Software engineer with a strong problem-solving background. Experienced in programming principles across multiple platforms, object-oriented programming, developing testing and debugging code. Quick learner of new technologies. Successful working in both team and self-directed settings.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Developed supplier-facing web applications in an agile environment using Python, TypeScript, and GCP.  
• Implemented analytics dashboards and led bug/performance fixes, achieving a 70% reduction in system defects.  
• Optimized microservices through caching and query tuning, cutting product upload time by 50%.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Served as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for workflows, leading the transition to a TypeScript monorepo architecture.  
• Developed reusable UI components in collaboration with UX, enhancing consistency across the supplier tech organization.  
• Introduced a Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) architecture using Next.js and Apollo Federation, improving system efficiency.  
• Migrated product search from Elasticsearch to Solr, ensuring data consistency and reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed scalable supplier tools utilizing PHP, React/Redux, and SQL to enhance vendor support.  
• Established team testing standards in PHP, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing through paired programming.  
• Led sprint ceremonies and provided detailed, pattern-aligned code reviews to improve code quality.  
• Resolved critical issues in legacy tools, significantly reducing downtime and enhancing operational efficiency.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
•	Fostered open and supportive community for 30 first-year floor residents by advising their transition to college, connecting them to resources, mediating conflicts and coordinating events using designated budget.
•	Collaborated with 26-person team to ensure safety, wellness and comfort for 700+ first-year building residents.
•	Enforced residence halls policy and responded to emergency and crisis situations.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
•	Managed online banking processes and maintained online customer database, resulting in a 20% increase in internet banking use.
•	Updated Android mobile application, which had last been updated in 2012, resulting in a significant reduction in application crashes.
•	Addressed technological problems and concerns among employees.

positions.title: Phone Surveyor
positions.description: •	Surveyed and polled students on internship experiences.
